items.text: In a governing coalition, keeps in place the existing tax system, in which tax revenue equals about 38 percent of annual economic output, the top tax rate on earnings is about 47 percent, starting at about 4 times the average wage, and the tax rate on company profits is about 30 percent counting local taxes.

In a governing coalition, keeps in place the existing rules, in which the minimum wage is about 50 percent of the median full-time wage, collective agreements cover about 49 percent of employees, and an employer with more than 10 employees needs a recognized reason to dismiss anyone employed over six months, must give notice of 4 weeks to 7 months depending on length of service, and must first hear worker representatives where they exist.

In a governing coalition, raised the minimum wage by about 8 percent for 2026 and a further 5 percent for 2027 by regulation, as a commission of employers and unions recommended. The government said more than 6 million workers benefit, about 13 percent of people in work.

In a governing coalition, approved a bill that would let employers offer fixed-term contracts without a stated reason for up to four years instead of two, and make it easier to end the employment of the highest earners, those paid above about 3 times the average wage, in exchange for severance.
Its coalition agreement pledges to replace the daily limit on working hours with a weekly one and to exempt extra pay for overtime from income tax.
